articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code, images, video, and audio within a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-bench and near-human performance on complex visual math reasoning tasks. The model also introduces a persistent memory architecture that maintains coherent context across sessions without explicit retrieval augmentation.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Discovery Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which set new records on MathOdyssey and ScienceBenchQA by autonomously generating and validating novel hypotheses in materials science. The system proposed three previously unknown stable crystal structures later confirmed through DFT simulations. Researchers highlight its chain-of-experimentation prompting framework as a paradigm shift toward AI-driven scientific workflows.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas Gen-3 with Dexterous Bi-Manual Manipulation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated the third-generation Atlas humanoid featuring redesigned hands with 22 degrees of freedom per limb and tactile sensing at fingertip resolution under 1mm. The robot performed live assembly of small electronic components, threading cables, and inserting connectors with sub-millimeter precision. The company announced commercial pilot programs with three automotive manufacturers beginning Q1 2027.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Robots Begin Supervised Shifts in Third-Party Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that Optimus Gen-3 humanoid robots are now operating supervised 8-hour shifts in two third-party logistics warehouses outside of Tesla's own facilities, performing pick-and-place, inventory scanning, and pallet organization. Throughput data indicates roughly 70% of human-equivalent speed with a 99.2% item-handling accuracy rate. This marks Tesla's first external commercial deployment of Optimus, a milestone for the humanoid robotics industry.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Defend Against Jailbreak and Prompt Injection Attacks
articles.summary: Anthropic published research on Constitutional Classifiers, a layered defense system that reduces successful jailbreak rates on Claude to under 0.3% across adversarial red-team evaluations. The approach trains lightweight classifier heads on constitutionally-generated contrastive examples, adding negligible latency while dramatically improving robustness. The technique is model-agnostic and Anthropic has open-sourced the training framework to encourage industry-wide adoption.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N14G process, the company's first full gate-all-around nanosheet node at 1.4nm-class density. Early yield data reportedly exceeds expectations, with a 20% power efficiency gain and 15% performance uplift over N2. Lead customers including Apple and NVIDIA are expected to tape out flagship chips on the node in early 2027, potentially reshaping the power-performance envelope for both mobile and datacenter AI accelerators.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error-Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced sustained fault-tolerant operation of 12 logical qubits with error rates below the surface-code correction threshold for over 100,000 consecutive gate cycles. This milestone marks the first demonstration of reliable quantum computation at a scale and duration relevant to near-term hybrid quantum-classical algorithms. The team outlined a roadmap to 100 logical qubits by late 2027 using their integrated trapped-ion architecture.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across Full Assembly Line
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across an entire vehicle sub-assembly line at BMW's Spartanburg plant, scaling from a single-station pilot to 48 robots operating collaboratively. The robots use on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without reprogramming. BMW reported a 30% reduction in line reconfiguration time, signaling that general-purpose humanoids are reaching practical ROI in advanced manufacturing.
